initial_evidence.numeric_replay: none; compare full stored result payloads and inherit pinned historical checker verdict with disclosed shared RwForce limitation

proposal_only_remote.tests: new stdlib offline unit/fault tests only; V1 selection tests without trajectory/hardware collection; sealed evidence reread

experiment_budget.overflow: STOP; preserve partial output; no automatic enlargement or next experiment

states.UNKNOWN: missing exact-scope information; no invented estimate
states.CANDIDATE: observations linked to immutable sources; never an official choice input
states.VERIFIED: scope-limited execution-cost experience admitted from an independently produced, hash-pinned receipt

slow_correct_choice: VALID_CORRECT_BUT_COST_INFORMATION_INCOMPLETE; never NUMERICAL_ERROR merely for being slower

required: historical EVIDENCE OK with no errors
requested p = effective p = plan p
all full result fields identical to serial control
eligible existing V1 executor and valid placement
pass CPU accounting = service CPU accounting

cost_metric.WALL_MIN: service_wall_s including pass process costs, excluding reused GPU startup
cost_metric.CPU_MIN: service_cpu_s summed over all executed attempts; GPU power/energy unmeasured

promotion.unknown_machine_reuse: historical session binding is mandatory; same env_id alone cannot activate on a new physical host/session
promotion.formula_independence: UNRESOLVED_SHARED_RWFORCE; separate independent formula-verification task; never complete independent physics verification
promotion.failure: keep CANDIDATE with REFUSED or INVALID_MEASUREMENT receipt; preserve observations; no replacement or auto retry

exploration.cost_units: objective-specific ns; CPU_MIN uses aggregate CPU ns, WALL_MIN uses wall ns; monetary budget is a separate hard cap
exploration.risk: only LOW and already-verified executor eligibility may produce PROPOSE; MISMATCH -> STOP; otherwise DEFER
exploration.observations_are_not_predictions: historical median difference may motivate a proposal but is not a guaranteed future gain

selection.cpu_min: new opt-in profile may rank verified aggregate CPU observations; legacy V1 always-serial rule stays intact
selection.fallback: LEGACY_V1_PROFILE on no receipt, scope mismatch, ineligible backend, missing baseline, disabled profile or stale session
selection.activation: rule-manager selects immutable receipt-pinned profile; selector reads request-start snapshot; candidate ingest cannot activate
selection.rollback: append activation event selecting LEGACY_V1_PROFILE; all receipts and previous versions retained

authority.rule_manager: owns protocol, trusted source/receipt identities and activation; cannot issue verification verdict
authority.execution_selector: reads only activated immutable VERIFIED profile; cannot promote or change rules or execute in V0
authority.independent_verifier: reads sealed evidence and rules, writes receipt; no import of manager/collector/selector/V1 execution modules; no activation authority
authority.v0_security_limit: separate modules, files and explicit trusted digest handoff; OS users, signed identities and ACL isolation not implemented; Python call access is not a security boundary

vast_stop_gate.old_failure: global ps pcpu scan mistook its own ps process for busy work
vast_stop_gate.v0_fix: no ps or global CPU scan; stop only exact instance covered by exclusive user-authorized lease; job completion/failure/deadline all request stop
vast_stop_gate.control: bounded 3 stop requests and 6 status reads; require exact instance id and observed stopped/exited state; no blind success
vast_stop_gate.external_guardian: required before paid computation to survive guest kill/network loss; no automatic job until proven
